corrected_text: litert-community offers Gemma 4 26B-A4B and 31B only as -gpu and -web .litertlm files. The E2B and E4B -gpu files carry a tf_lite_artisan_text_decoder section, which makes EngineSettings switch a GPU engine to Backend::GPU_ARTISAN, and the documented build's CreateLlmLiteRtCompiledModelExecutor rejects any backend other than CPU, GPU and NPU (LM-FMT-017). If the 26B-A4B and 31B files are built the same way (their sections were not inspected), the documented agello-next build cannot run them.

corrected_text: The Gemma 4 technical report's Table 3 (arXiv 2607.02770v1, unit labelled 'Gb') lists INT8 KV cache at 32k context as +0.05 (E2B), +0.14 (E4B), +0.28 (12B), +0.28 (26B-A4B) and +1.10 (31B); config arithmetic (MOD-FAM-043) gives 0.104, 0.279, 0.302, 0.273 and 1.091 GB, so the report's E2B and E4B figures are about half the arithmetic (0.48x and 0.50x). Halving only the global-layer term gives 53.5 MB and 144.7 MB, which round to the report's 0.05 and 0.14.
